verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://supabase.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a link to the full documentation file, and a separate probe confirms a machine-discoverable agent-skills index at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json that lists skills across Database, Auth, Functions, Realtime, Storage, Vectors, Cron, and Queues — directly matching the 'point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs' story. This is reinforced by first-party docs on AI tools, plugins, and agent skills (supabase-docs-2, -3, -19) and the skills CLI installer (supabase-docs-44). Missing for 10: the per-page docs.md endpoint returned 404 (not all doc pages have markdown mirrors) and there's no independent/community report of an agent actually consuming llms.txt in practice.
